description: This file defines the BrowserTestDriver class, which extends the Driver class to facilitate running browser-based print preview tests, managing stdin paths, command line construction, and process control.

classes.name: BrowserTestDriver
classes.description: A class for running print preview tests using browser tests, managing stdin paths, and controlling the test process.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BrowserTestDriver, invoking the superclass constructor.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the browser test, waits for stdin file path, and manages process startup.

methods.name: _open_stdin_path
methods.description: Opens the stdin file for the browser test if the path is found.

methods.name: _read_stdin_path
methods.description: Reads the stdin file path from the test block.

methods.name: cmd_line
methods.description: Constructs the command line arguments to run the browser test.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the test process by sending 'QUIT' and invoking superclass stop.
